ns2:course.label: Human Origins and Culture
ns2:course.description: Introduction to human evolutionary biology focusing on the biological processes responsible for our evolution. Draws on a diverse range of disciplines- evolutionary biology, population genetics, comparative anatomy, primatology, archaeology, geology and paleoecology to provide context for interpreting the fossil and archaeological evidence for humans' biological origin and evolution and early cultural change.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
